lede: The biggest civic action this week happens Thursday, when the San Miguel County Planning Commission and BOCC sit down together to work through proposed Land Use Code amendments covering forestry practices, oil and gas operations, deep geothermal, and condominium plats — no final votes, but this is where the shape of those rules gets decided. Earlier in the week, the Open Space Commission takes up real trail-routing choices on the Valley Floor, and the commissioners make a rare West End trip to Norwood on Wednesday for a community meeting on the Placerville Fire Survey.

notable.stake: Commission picks Valley Floor trail alignments affecting wetlands and open space access.
Board appoints Planning Commission alternate and hears Placerville Fire Survey results.
Land Use Code rewrites on forestry, oil/gas, geothermal, and condos take shape here.
